title: Crafting Alterations
description: Expanding apon current crafting recipes adding ways to craft un-craftable blocks and items.
body: Adding new crafting Recipes for existing things in the game Crafting Alterations is the New and Improved "GemShrooms Re-crafted". This Mod aims to enhance the vanilla experience or make the modded experience easier with new crafting recipes from Smelting Rotten flesh into Leather all the way to Crafting Spawners.
